sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Obliterators are buildable structures that convert any item to Coal.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text:
Put gifts to Thor into the Obliterator and pull the lever on the right side, giving the player coal in return.
When activated, lightning strikes the lightning rod above the Obliterator dealing 400 Lightning damage and additional 10 Lightning damage within 2.42 meters.

sections.heading: Conversion rates
sections.text:
To get 1 coal, insert:
• 1 Trophy, including boss trophies, except trophies from Ashlands creatures, Hildir minibosses, Bear, Vile and Ghost.
• 5 Wood, Corewood, Finewood, Ancient bark, or Yggdrasil wood.
• 20 Arrows, except (Charred arrow)
• 20 Bolts, except (Iron bolt and Charred bolt)
• 10 of other items (including coal)

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The Obliterator can be placed anywhere on a flat surface and does not degrade due to rain.
• The Obliterator generates its own lightning bolt and does not require a thunderstorm to operate.
• Wood and meats can be converted to coal at a 1:1 conversion rate using a Charcoal kiln or cooking station, making it resource-inefficient to place these in the Obliterator.
• Currently, many trophies after Mistlands do not share the 1:1 conversion rate as other trophies, including Hildir's minibosses.
